svg.title: The matched expected upper budget decreases by more than 18.6%. A finite-command implementation whose separate phase-error certificate gives risk at most .0088 instead has expected source stock below 10243551.605. That third entry is conditional on its independently checked physical-command allowance, rather than silently treating real-valued commands as free. The smaller planning risk is not assumed for an arbitrary uncalibrated device; it defines the good-device class on which the acceptance-cost promise holds. False-certificate control remains valid outside that class. The second planning case is used only after the frozen policy’s mathematical risk bound is independently checked. Section 3 proves the matching terminal-score lower bound ENh ≥A/D for every validator with false-certificate size α and almost-sure acceptance at the all-p0 good vector.
